about: Taber is a town in southern Alberta on Highway 3 east of Lethbridge, in irrigated prairie famous for sweet corn—not the surrounding Municipal District of Taber. A compact downtown, sugar-beet and corn agriculture, and a regional service role define the community. About 9,000 people live in the Town of Taber.
